won.source: Won from Shane Douglas at CaliQuake '97, 16 Oct 1997 (promotions/pccw/archive/caliquake-97-1997-10-16-part4.html).

how: Defeated Shane Douglas, who was written out of PCCW in the same segment.

label: Paul-Dog
how: Pinned Ajax Shiva after the Aerial Marauder tripped Shiva mid-move, robbing him of a third finisher.

won.source: Won from New Jack and John Kronus at CaliQuake '97, 16 Oct 1997 (promotions/pccw/archive/caliquake-97-1997-10-16-part3.html).

how: Sledge Hammer pinned Kronus after New Jack abandoned the match; Kronus was legitimately injured on the play.
note: Retained against the Yakuza's own Danger Zone Alliance rivals at Jersey Jams -- "our first title defense ever."

title: pccw-world-light-heavyweight
label: El Jobbo Grande

won.source: At least two separate reigns are attested in this wing's own served corpus (an upset win over Al Snow, wrestling as 'Leif Cassidy,' and a later re-win over Sean Southward shortly before Jersey Jams); the held record does not support dating either precisely, recorded here as one representative reign.

lost.source: Billed a 'former' champion again by Jersey Jams, 30 Nov 1997; how he lost the title does not survive.

note: See this title's own epitaph for the full attested sequence (Syxx -> Al Snow -> El Jobbo Grande -> Sean Southward -> El Jobbo Grande).
